latestRelease.body:
* Improved Kernel Panic by @Mellurboo a more verbose, better looking panic screen so we can diagnose your problem better!
* Fixed text cut off with optionally padded bounding box & Kernel Panic Grammer fix by @Mellurboo this fixes text cutoff
* feat: add small ASCII art logo option to sysfetch by @RicePollution for smaller screens, you can optionally use a smaller logo
* fix: resolve OS freeze on terminal input by @RicePollution 
* Refactoring the explorer by @Lluciocc, A beautiful new explorer experience replacing the old outdated one, looks better and feels better.

As we get closer to Release-26.6.0 we are getting more and more exited with the amazing contributions and growth of the project
And with the great rework we get closer to posix compliance, this is just a small stepping stone to what will be something for
All to enjoy.

Keep the issues and pre coming we love them all!
